_note: P1-06 golden set for taxonomy.match_family(). 50 resume fragments.
AUTHORED BEFORE THE SCORER WAS WRITTEN, deliberately. A golden set written
after the implementation is a description of the implementation, not a test
of it. If an entry here is wrong, fix the entry and say so in the PR — do
not fix it by widening the taxonomy until it passes.
Entries carrying `family` are scored for accuracy (M5b).
Entries carrying `ambiguous: true` are EXCLUDED from accuracy and assert
low confidence instead: they are genuinely two families at once, and a
router that claims certainty about them is lying. `plausible` records which
The prose is deliberately not keyword-stuffed. Real resumes bury two or
three signals in ordinary sentences, and a router tuned on dense keyword
soup will look far better here than it does in production.
